Q01.evidence: Even though citizen scientists may not have science degrees or long, white lab coats, they are still capable of making valuable contributions to science.
issues: 지문 중 'these two projects'가 발췌 밖 Galaxy Zoo까지 가리킴(정답 무관)
오답 4개가 모두 본문 정반대 진술이라 난도 낮음
⑤ 'too ordinary to lead to new knowledge'는 다소 부자연스러운 연어

Q02.evidence: his job there was dull and time-consuming (exciting도, 시간이 적게 든 것도 아님)
issues: ⑤가 exciting·tiny amount 두 군데 모두 틀려 쉽게 드러남(낮음)

Q03.evidence: notice something strange appearing in the night sky ... discovered a new type of phenomenon that had never been properly studied
issues: 난도 낮음

Q04.evidence: In reality, science belongs to everyone, and we all have the ability to play a role in the advancement of science.
issues: 지문 후반(Schawinski의 지루한 분류 작업)은 주장과 직접 연결되지 않는 도입 사례로, 정답이 지문 전반부만 포괄(낮음)

Q05.evidence: If it had not been for those participants, Schawinski couldn’t have classified that many images. / Galaxy Zoo has now grown into Zooniverse
issues: ⑤ 개인정보 위험은 본문과 무관한 별개 이야기(1개 허용 범위)
난도 낮음

Q06.evidence: some of which seemed to stretch for thousands of kilometers
issues: ⑤ NASA는 이 발췌에 등장하지 않음(이름은 group이 붙였다는 근거로 배제 가능, 문제 없음)

Q07.evidence: neither of them had any idea what Steve was ... not an aurora ... did not resemble anything they had seen before
issues: 정답 선지 'properly'가 원표현 낱말과 같음(빈칸 가려져 있어 노출 아님)
지문 약 123단어(원형)로 고2 빈칸 표본 대비 짧을 가능성 — 2단계에서 표본 대조 필요

Q08.evidence: (C) launching ... Galaxy Zoo / kept as simple → (A) This allowed ... tutorial → (B) Then they were shown ...
issues: 주어진 글의 'the situation'이 발췌 밖 분류 작업을 가리킴(이해 가능, 낮음)
(B) 끝 문장 'It was online media...'는 다음 단락 첫 문장이며 같은 회 Q05 첫 문장과 동일(정답 노출은 아님)

Q09.evidence: them = the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group that deserve the credit for discovering STEVE
issues: 'these two projects' 발췌 밖 지시(정답 무관)
④ 위치는 'them=Scientists and citizens'로 읽힐 여지가 있으나 remained unnoticed(발견 문맥)와 맞지 않아 배제 가능

Q10.evidence: science belongs to everyone ... / It took Schawinski a whole week to classify just 50,000 galaxies
issues: 어휘 오류 ② much가 제목 근거를 훼손하지 않음 확인
장문 200단어로 고2 41~42 표본 대비 짧을 가능성
오답이 모두 명백히 무관·정반대라 난도 낮음

Q11.evidence: much → little: 'However, this perception is far from the truth'와 대비되려면 평범한 사람과 공통점이 거의 없다는 인식이어야 함

Q12.evidence: a domain reserved exclusively for scientists ... They seem to have very little in common with ordinary people like us.
issues: 표적 표현이 거의 문자 그대로여서 함축성이 약하고 오답(③④⑤)이 황당해 매우 쉬움
판단 근거는 첫 단락뿐이며 뒤 Schawinski 단락은 발문과 무관한 덧붙임(분량용)
같은 회 Q14 지문의 'long, white lab coats'가 보조 힌트(정답 노출 수준은 아님)

Q13.evidence: There are many interesting theories about STEVE, but none of them have been proven for certain.
issues: 같은 회 Q16과 전문가·NASA 단락이 겹치고 ③ 'NASA supported a project'가 Q16 요약문과 같은 표현(정답 노출은 아님)

Q14.evidence: Even though ... may not have science degrees ..., they are still ___ / The next great scientific achievement could be made by citizen scientists
issues: 'these two projects' 발췌 밖 지시(정답 무관)
③ NASA는 이 발췌에 등장하지 않음(배제 가능)

Q15.evidence: ④ 망원경 관측 선호 문장은 참여자 기여 흐름과 무관, ⑤ 'him'이 ③의 Schawinski를 이어받음

Q16.evidence: neither of them had any idea what Steve was / NASA funded a citizen science project involving the public ... asked ordinary people to gather photos
issues: 요약문 'When aurora chasers noticed ..., NASA supported'는 시간 관계가 부정확(관찰 후 수년 뒤 전문가 확인 → NASA 지원). 'After ...' 등으로 다듬기 권장(낮음)

Q17.evidence: classify around one million images ... Lintott suggested that he turn to the Internet ... launching a crowdsourced online project
issues: 어휘 오류 ② complicated가 제목 근거를 훼손하지 않음 확인

Q18.evidence: complicated → simple: with a very basic design and an easy-to-use interface / allowed ... to get started quickly

Q19.evidence: You can become one as well if you have curiosity and an interest in taking part in scientific research.
issues: 'these two projects' 발췌 밖 지시(정답 무관)
Q01·Q09·Q14와 같은 발췌 범위(유형 반복은 허용)

Q20.evidence: kept as simple as possible ... brief tutorial ... the participants were able to classify galaxies effectively
issues: 'the situation' 발췌 밖 지시(낮음)

Q21.evidence: similar in appearance to auroras, yet ... ___ (yet의 대조)

Q22.evidence: far from the truth → (B) In reality ... two of them → (C) Kevin Schawinski ... classify images → (A) Since they all looked similar ... do this

Q23.evidence: ② 뒤 'In fact, it would have taken him decades on his own'의 him이 주어진 문장의 Schawinski를 필요로 함

Q24.evidence: Experts have acknowledged that it is the dedicated members of the aurora chasers group that deserve the credit for discovering STEVE.
issues: 어휘 오류 ④ canceled가 제목 근거를 훼손하지 않음 확인

Q25.evidence: canceled → funded 류: In order to learn more about it ... / It is still in progress today.
